source_status.exact_result: Unverified proof draft of a finite pointed-cell generator-contact/PCC-witness certificate and an explicit genuinely nonseparable envelope/obstacle family on the specified cyclic triangle graph squared. For c>0, rational 0<r<1 and eta,epsilon>0, gamma=c(g1+g2), H=c max(g1+g2,r), S=(r-g1-g2)_+, f=H+eta S+epsilon T with T on BC times BC have actual raw envelope H, real PAPC uniform regularization and complete recursive contact. A tight rational-endpoint PCC bounds the noncontact product junction (A,A); its full recursive coefficient is zero. The operator has fourteen positive atoms, total mass 128 c^2, includes index-two cones, and the exact contact integral is zero. The certificate also permits arbitrary bounded nonnegative rational-domain real-PA lifts vanishing at the fourteen positive-mass vertices and PC positive-growth bounded reference shifts. It does not cover arbitrary references/obstacles on this product.
concrete_gaps: No global raw-envelope construction for arbitrary nonseparable data on two finite graph factors, including both cyclic factors.
No all-obstacle triangle-square theorem; the certificate requires a supplied candidate and finite obstacle-contact or tight PCC-witness bounds at its spatial vertices.
No universal finite rational-domain regularization or product-junction contact theorem and no actual negative-integral counterexample.
Original P05.2 arbitrary balanced-pair classification remains open; P06.2 is not addressed.
All proof claims are author drafts; execution and compilation do not independently verify them.
